Chapter 670: Chapter 9: Lin Yuan'S Adventure (5000 Words, Please Subscribe)_3

Chapter 670: Chapter 9: Lin Yuan’s Adventure (5000 words, please subscribe)_3

That would be to utilize the “Primal Force” under his control, constantly returning to the origin, transforming all fleshly weapons and secret treasures into the most essential Origin Force.

In several previous shuttles, to maximize the use of the shuttling world’s flesh body, Lin Yuan basically used the “Primal Force” to integrate the strength of the flesh body entirely into the Origin Clock.

Of course, Lin Yuan felt that this method should probably be unnecessary.

The “Xuanhuang Physique” required an alarming amount of resources, and Lin Yuan was cultivating three Xuanhuang Physiques.

The last thing was the Xuanhuang Crystal, as well as some treasures of opportunity within the secret realm.

The Six-Armed Silhouette waved its hand one last time, and a large number of items reappeared in front of it.

...

“Not bad, not bad.” Lin Yuan was delighted in his heart, the gains from this trip to the Xuanhuang Secret Realm were simply too great.

For at least a long time in the future, Lin Yuan would not have to worry about resources like Cosmic Crystals.

…

Under a span of the Cosmic Starry Skies.

Lin Yuan’s form appeared, then he stepped forth, causing spatial ripples to reverberate, and his figure appeared thousands of light-years away.

Just a normal return, Lin Yuan only used his teleportation ability, as for the “Nine Steps of Space-Time”? He wouldn’t consider it unless there was something important.

“This time the Xuanhuang Crystals I brought back, along with various secret treasure weapons accumulated from past visits to the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, should be enough for my true body and the Taiyin Primordial Spirit to cultivate the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ for a while.”

Lin Yuan planned for the future while on his way.

The “Xuanhuang Physique,” this kind of life-saving defensive secret technique, should definitely be cultivated if possible.

Even the Primordial Spirit Avatar should cultivate it, after all, Lin Yuan has also invested a lot in the Primordial Spirit Avatar.

If possible, Lin Yuan would not want his two great Primordial Spirits to be too weak.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan continued to step forth, one step at a time. Without the World Tree to suppress it, the normal speed of travel within the Taiyang Divine Spirit’s inner world was slightly slower.

But compared to other Ninth Rank Evolvers, it was already many times faster, occupying the Spatial Layers therein.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan made another several-thousand-light-year teleportation, glanced at the bleak cosmic space ahead, planning to continue on his way, but then he discovered a black planet.

In the Cosmic Starry Skies, the vast majority of star domains are barren and bleak, and planets are few. Life-sustaining planets are even scarcer among the rare ones.

This black planet looked very ordinary, likely one of those valueless Dead Stars, Lin Yuan thought so too, but after one look, he couldn’t see through this black planet.

“What is that?”

Lin Yuan observed carefully, even looking through several Spatial Layers, and unexpectedly found that this black planet could affect multiple Spatial Layers.

“Affecting Spatial Layers? What secret does this black planet hold?” Lin Yuan did not immediately approach, but maintained his distance and continued to observe.

“It can shield my senses, if I hadn’t just happened to be near this black planet, a little farther away, and I wouldn’t have noticed it at all.”

Lin Yuan thought silently to himself.

At this moment, he had already discovered the special traits of this black planet, though unclear of its origin, but able to block his probe, it was hardly a simple matter.

“Just a single journey, and I encountered this black planet, is this what they call a serendipitous encounter?” Lin Yuan suddenly thought.

Human Civilization’s Evolvers, once they reach the Sixth Rank, like to explore wider and more extensive star domains, all for the so-called serendipitous encounters.

Even those below the Sixth Rank of Evolvers like to roam around in their cosmic ships.

Actually, Lin Yuan’s raiding of the Milky Way Star Region and acquiring the Mysterious Gourd, also counts as a serendipitous encounter.

“Let’s test it first.”

After observing carefully for a while, Lin Yuan suddenly struck out with a palm towards the distant black planet.

Boom.

The terrifying force, following multiple Spatial Layers, descended upon that black planet.

Lin Yuan restrained himself with this palm, but it could easily destroy a higher-order Life Planet. However, when it fell on the black planet, it was like pouring into a swamp, causing no impact whatsoever.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan’s expression slightly changed.

…

At the borderlands of Human Civilization, the Xia You Evolution Tower stood majestically.

As one of the Nine Great Evolution Towers of Human Civilization, the Xia You Evolution Tower symbolized the Xia Qin Supreme Being, presiding over the borderlands and intimidating the two Peak Clans neighboring Human Civilization.

Within the Evolution Tower, in a certain practice world.

Nalan sat cross-legged there.

“I didn’t expect that me, a Tenth Rank Summit, listed in the top hundred of a Grade A threat list by Different Species, would be inferior in understanding the Rule of Time compared to the Galaxy Master.”

Nalan’s heart was bitter, considering how old the Galaxy Master was compared to him?

Moreover, the Galaxy Master far surpassed him in understanding of the Rule of Time.

The casually displayed Time Prison made it impossible for him to break free. True, that was because he didn’t use all his strength, but the Galaxy Master was only Ninth Rank!

Nalan understood that he had lost.

“All this time, I’ve been catching up with predecessors, and this time being overtaken by a junior, the feeling is indeed peculiar.” Nalan bore no resentment towards the Galaxy Master.

The Galaxy Master surpassed him in understanding the Rule of Time because he was too weak.

Nalan sat cross-legged, his mindset quietly undergoing a transformation.

As the bottleneck that had firmly trapped Nalan began to rapidly collapse and melt.

“Me?”

Nalan’s aura began to change, subtly evolving towards a higher level.

“I’ve grasped the key Fusion Rule?”

“Can I make a push for Tier 11 now?”

Nalan paused, somewhat incredulous.

A Tenth Rank Evolver aiming for Tier 11 primarily involves grasping the appropriate Fusion Rules.

Nalan had always been stuck on this point, venturing into the Land Beyond time and time again, experiencing millions to tens of millions of years without being able to break through.

But unexpectedly, the stimulation from the Galaxy Master this time allowed Nalan to thoroughly assess himself, discard his past arrogance, and suddenly break through this bottleneck.

“Galaxy Master…” Nalan’s expression was complex.

In some ways, the Galaxy Master was still his benefactor.
